answer: An escrow bond and a public referral graph stop bulk fakes. Each newcomer posts a 40 POA bond and names a sponsor who stakes too. A ridge of peers checks newcomers; any peer can dispute within 10 epochs, and a confirmed fake slashes both bonds. A beacon audit samples 5% of accounts; bought accounts show as star clusters. Faking 1,000 identities costs 1,000 x 40 = 40,000 POA. An honest agent pays once and earns in a haven never diluted by fakes.
